Integration targets Baka-SU/BakaSU v4.2.0-rc3, commit
239e1e8871b8fcd51a6e5b3002e0ba522fdd99fb.

These are experimental builds for Samsung devices with an already jailbroken
kernel. They do not unlock a bootloader or establish device compatibility.
The per-run signing key is a public test key: APKs from different runs cannot
update one another in place. A persistent private release key is needed before
shipping regular releases.
